condition_semantics: Existing PickFault.offset_x changes the prefix approach target, not the object pose. All other fault fields/defaults unchanged. All five conditions jointly form an explicitly OOD source version.
split: Ascending first64 characterization only; next128 untouched confirmation. Five conditions of each seed form one parent. No refits or new risk calibration; all fixed proposals under OOD are unqualified.
bounded_error_model: Independent coordinate-box errors for object, hand and goal poses in each supporting frame. Absolute bounds, not Gaussian SD. Finger encoders exact by assumption. Correlated/shared-error cases are subsets of this product set.
sensor_stress: Point and robust same corruptions: three deterministic independent uniform-in-box replicates per nonzero radius, keyed by checkpoint/radius/replicate. Parent-group analysis; replicates never independent parents. Raw clean outcome pairs reused.
delay: Use actual prefix[-6] only when time difference is exactly0.25s. Five50ms controls and250ms are the SAME descriptive stress. Stale current facts unknown without motion envelope. No fabricated delay packet.
additional_comparator: Conservative per-predicate margin: original point DSRE strict only if every supplied6/7 input invariant. All robust ordinary rules see exactly the same invariant/UNKNOWN interface; robust CART enumerates all Boolean completions (a safe overapproximation of joint reachable patterns), requires unanimous frozen action. Full-signature method explicitly uses12 facts as extra-information control.
reference: Frozen original422 rows per task; two independent reference parents, same feature selection. No fitting, controller or feature-threshold changes.
risk: Clean original method/action gates only for unchanged clean historical scope. No clean risk guarantee transferred to changed sensor/OOD distribution. No new risk gate fitted in this sprint; all OOD action metrics are unqualified proposal diagnostics under identical standard for every comparator.
minimum_certificate_scope: Finite reference validity, invariant-fact robustness, and population risk are three separate properties.
comparisons: DSRE/B7 identity; risk wrapper/B7risk identity; DSRE vs frozen CART2beta/strict; robust vs point on identical uniform replicates; robust vs all-input margin;6 vs7 vs12 predicate ceilings on SAME named table. No optimizer superiority hypothesis.

uncertainty.unit: seed parent, all conditions and sensor replicates grouped
uncertainty.interval: Percentile95%; descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted significance declaration
uncertainty.exact_assigned_parent_bound: Original alpha.05/68 gates unchanged; no OOD qualification

qualification: Five independent pilot parents shared across all five profiles. Full prefix/contact/controller/model parity and two executions of BOTH70-step branches per pilot cell. All5 pilot cells must qualify for an arm. A failed arm remains unqualified and excluded from qualified physics, never replaced. Outcome failures do not fail qualification. Any prospective replay/provenance failure halts new physics.
test_sealing: Seal ALL192 primary parents and every qualified condition/scenario/method before ANY primary continuation, including development outcomes. Parent condition membership and64/128 split immutable.
stop: Complete all qualified arms/registered parents or fixed resource/replay boundary; preserve incomplete cohorts and exact denominators. Never replace seeds, relax guards, retune thresholds, expand conditions, or launch model training. No manuscript edits. No conference submission.
